Sonam Wangchuk comments on CJP leaders' political ambitions

Activist Sonam Wangchuk stated that leaders of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) are not saints and harbor political ambitions. Wangchuk made these remarks regarding CJP leaders Abhijit Dipke, Teesta Setalvad, and Girija Shankar Ranka. The comments were reported by Navbharat Times and Hindustan.
